events.title: 리버풀 sell midfielder Nigel Spackman to 퀸스 파크 레인저스 for £500,000.
Midfielder 피터 리드 moves from 에버턴 to 퀸스 파크 레인저스 on a free transfer. 왓퍼드 boost their Second Division promotion challenge with a £175,000 move for Halifax Town's 19-year-old winger Lee Richardson .

노팅엄 포리스트 manager 브라이언 클러프 is fined £5,000 and banned from the touchline for the rest of the season for punching supporters who invaded the pitch in the recent League Cup quarter-final victory over 퀸스 파크 레인저스.

Just three months after quitting 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 to take over at Spanish side 아틀레티코 마드리드, Ron Atkinson returns to England to succeed Peter Eustace as manager of First Division strugglers 셰필드 웬즈데이. 아스널 win a friendly against the France national football team 2–0.
리버풀 come from behind to beat 헐 시티 3–2 in the FA Cup fifth round. 에버턴 win 1–0 at 반즐리, and Third Division 브렌트퍼드 continue their good run by beating 블랙번 로버스.
Midfielder Carlton Palmer follows Ron Atkinson to 셰필드 웬즈데이 from 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 for a club record fee of £750,000.
Roy Hattersley , deputy Labour Party leader, warns that the Conservative government's proposed ID card scheme will increase violence outside football grounds.
뉴포트 카운티, relegated from the Football League last season, are wound up in the High Court with huge debts.

아스널 remain top of the First Division as February ends, with 노리치 시티 still second, and 밀월 back up to third. 리버풀 are eighth, 19 points behind 아스널, but with four games in hand. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are now bottom of the division, and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 셰필드 웬즈데이 complete the relegation zone. 맨체스터 시티 have overtaken 첼시 as Second Division leaders. The play-off zone is occupied by 블랙번 로버스, 왓퍼드, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 본머스.
